steps.title: Intention
steps.text: A mental state only — never punishable

steps.title: Preparation
steps.text: Arranging means — punishable only by special sections

steps.title: Attempt
steps.text: An act towards commission beyond preparation, which fails

steps.title: Commission
steps.text: The full offence with its actus reus and mens rea

rootSub: the accused must prove the facts (Art. 121, Qanun-e-Shahadat) on a preponderance of probability

children.title: Mistake and authority
bullets: s. 76 — bound by law / mistake of fact

children.title: No guilty mind
bullets: s. 80 — accident in a lawful act

children.title: Consent
bullets: ss. 90–93 — limits; no consent possible; communication

children.title: Compulsion
bullets: Not murder or capital offences against the State

title: Private defence of the body — may death be caused?

q.ask: Is there an offence (or attempt / threat) affecting the body of the accused or another?
Was there time to seek the protection of the public authorities?
Was the attacker a public servant acting in good faith under colour of office, without threat of death or grievous hurt?
Was the assault of a kind in s. 100 — fear of death or GH, rape, unnatural lust, kidnapping / abduction, confinement without recourse?
q.yes: Right extends to causing death (s. 100), if no more harm than necessary

q.ask: Did the apprehension of danger still continue when the harm was caused?

root.title: Abetment of a thing
root.sub: a substantive offence — the act need not be committed (s. 108, Expl. 2)

children.title: Instigation
children.sub: goading, urging; wilful misrepresentation or concealment (Expl. 1)

children.title: Conspiracy
children.sub: agreement + an act or illegal omission in pursuance

children.title: Intentional aid
children.sub: facilitating before or at the time of the act (Expl. 2)
